{{Infobox Species |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Hylian Retriever Model.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Hylian Retriever Model.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |game= BotW, TotK |other= |era= [[Era of the Wilds]] |habitat= {{Spawn Locations}} |attack= |weapon= |characteristics= |members= [[Satty]] |theme= }} '''Hylian Retrievers''' are recurring [[Creature]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Hylian Retriever|Hylian Retrievers|Series, BotW, TotK}} | {{List| * {{BotW}} * {{TotK}} }} }} ==Characteristics== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract|Hylian Retriever}} Hylian Retrievers are a type of [[Dog]] often found at [[Stable]]s and settlements throughout [[Hyrule|Hyrule Kingdom]]. They are omnivorous, and will eat certain [[Material]]s, such as [[Meat]]s, [[Fruit]]s, and vegetables, if they are nearby. They will also move around a lot more than any other domesticated animal, chasing their own tails, rolling onto their backs, crouching down. After being exposed to [[Rain]], they will shake their bodies to dry themselves off. Hylian Retrievers have been commonly referred to as "man's best friend" since ancient times. Due to their intelligence and obedience, they are also great at watching over livestock. In addition to this, it is believed that all modern Retrievers are descended from a Dog owned by a former [[King of Hyrule]]. If [[Link]] stands close to or feeds a Hylian Retriever, it will become happy, signified by a pink blush effect appearing around its head. While it is happy, the Dog will follow Link around a short distance. If Link feeds a Retriever three times while it is happy, it will lead Link to a buried [[Treasure Chest]] nearby. ====List of Dog Treasures==== {{Data Table |game= BotW |columns= Location [Term], It's said that all Hylian retrievers are descendants of the dog once owned by the king of Hyrule.|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}} {{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 163}} {{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 349}} {{Cite Web|quote= Hello, everyone.

I'm Hidemaro Fujibayashi, director of The Legend of Zelda™: Breath of the Wild.

I'll be updating you with some useful tips about the game. And if you own the game, you may even get some free in-game items for reading. I hope you all look forward to it!

Now, today's useful tip is about dogs.

{{Color BotW|TW Blue|Spoilers ahead!}}

---------------------------------------------------------------

On your journey, you may have already come across some of the many stables dotted across Hyrule. But did you know that you can befriend the dogs at these stables? The dogs will start to like you if you spend some time with them, so stand nearby and be good company. Once they are happy, try feeding them three pieces of meat or three pieces of fruit. They may even find a nice surprise for you!

To get you on your way, please accept this in-game gift of two apples and one piece of meat. If you start your game by using the link below, the items will appear in your game. Just make sure that you either have the game card inserted or the digital version of the game on your system.

We hope to enjoy making some furry friends! |author= Hidemaro Fujibayashi |published= August 9, 2017 |retrieved= October 5, 2017|url= |title= Befriend a dog with these free, in-game treats for The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild |site= |type=}} {{Cite|'''Hylian Retriever'''|Hyrule Compendium|TotK}} }} {{Categories |Animals, Creatures, Dogs |species= BotW, TotK }}
